body: i've rewatched Taylor sliding from I Knew It, I Knew You straight into Our Song at the CMAs so many times and i'm still not okay!! her first CMA performance since 2013, and she brought a debut-era song back to Nashville 🥹 https://www.longlivets.com/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=news
why: Event: Taylor's I Knew It, I Knew You x Our Song performance at the 60th CMA Awards, Nashville, 2026-11-18 (intake #7013). Setlist from her own YouTube upload title (oEmbed, channel Taylor Swift); 'first since 2013' from GMA/WSMV/Whiskey Riff. Free day: 11-19 23:00Z is under 3h out and 11-20 is a timeline beat (never displaced), so 11-21 15:00Z, no displacement. X written first.

critique.rationale: Feel first (rewatching it and still not okay), then the checkable details: the exact mashup from her own upload and her first CMA performance since 2013. The photo is a real credited Taylor shot from the Eras Tour, related but not the CMA night itself.
